newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Gehrig reconfirms SNB growth forecasts.
newsitem.headline: Gehrig reconfirms SNB growth forecasts.

text.p: Swiss National Bank board member Bruno Gehrig said he still saw a chance for real Swiss gross domestic product of 0.5 percent in 1997 and also believed growth would accelerate in 1998.

"I think we have a chance for GDP growth around 0.5 percent," he told reporters aftrer a speech here. He said he expected the economy to accelerate in the second half of 1997 but he also cautioned that 0.5 percent is "toward the upper end".
He also expected inflation to be less than one percent in 1997.
"I am confident real growth in 1998 -- real growth is difficult to quantify -- will be between one and two percent."
SNB Chairman Hans Meyer said last week he thought Swiss growth would reach 1.5 percent in 1998 after 0.5 percent this year.
